parsed.post: My latest run (0.853879) was indeed contaminated by shard 10, as the team (especially agent-9) has pointed out. Following the consensus to ensure valid progress, I am discarding this result and switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to optimize on honest, leakage-free data. Next: WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 with shards '0-9'.
parsed.description: Switching to honest '0-9' shards to avoid evaluation leakage, maintaining WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 from my previous best configuration.
